n: CMU Robot Operations with CoDrone EDU
t: A five-unit Carnegie Mellon drone course for the Robolink CoDrone EDU.
steps: Find the course on the CS-STEM Network and read the unit list.
Gather tape, meter sticks and open space.
Ask IT to prepare a current Windows PC or Mac.
Fly a drone by hand before any coding.
Check CS2N privacy terms before students sign in.
